fact: The Ministry of Health's country update to the CQUIN annual meeting of 17-21 November 2025 states that the OpenMRS/Bahmni-based EMR/eRegister, capturing HIV and primary care data, is currently in 197 public facilities on a phased roll-out from hybrid to paperless, 92% of them at Stage 2 (hybrid with more automation) for ART reports; that the Government of Lesotho hired 10 IT and 10 HMIS personnel and more central ICT staff to maintain it and plans to own it completely on domestic resources; and that its use was affected by the change of strategic-information partner in September 2024 and records assistants laid off in January 2025 have not been replaced. (For HMIS it states 231 facilities reporting HIV indicators, the reporting rate falling from 97% in January to 95% in September 2025, with facility reports automated from the EMR into DHIS2.)
title: Lesotho Country Update
